note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The two scenes are identical except for ONE supplied fact (whether a later card is supplied to the intake tray), which changes the sequence: only in B is card A pushed into the history pocket, where it stays visible. Neither scene is a winner; both cards have the same size, stroke and ink; no rule, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. OMITTED brief fields: grounds, routes and outcomes — the intake tray, the position and the history pocket and the supplied states are shown physically in both scenes and named once in the shared facts; repeating them as text in each scene would crowd the paired scenes.
